label: 🌊 우키요에 × 목판화 × 은선세공 — 30·40·50대
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body group shot.
Three women standing in a row with NO GAP between them, arranged left to right.
LEFT: mid thirties. CENTER: mid forties. RIGHT: early fifties.
All three dramatic hourglass figures, narrow waists flaring to broad rounded hips.
LEFT hair: black, blunt bob cut at the jaw. CENTER hair: dark auburn, sculpted finger-wave. RIGHT hair: silver-white, long and glass-straight.

POSE — ALL STANDING, three different stances, staggered in DEPTH:
LEFT stands half a step FORWARD, angled away at 45 degrees with hips turned back, torso twisting forward so the chest rotates toward the lens, head turned over the shoulder.
CENTER stands half a step BACK, in near-profile at 70 degrees, spine long, chest opening toward the lens, one arm lifted to shoulder height.
RIGHT stands square to the camera in deep contrapposto, outer hip pushed far to one side, one hand on that hip.
CONTACT: LEFT's inner hand rests on CENTER's shoulder; RIGHT's inner hand rests on CENTER's opposite shoulder.

Body fully painted with: printed line illustration, no unpainted ground anywhere.
LEFT — ukiyo-e woodblock key-block: bold outline drawing of wave crests, pine boughs and drifting cloud bands, filled with the flat colour blocks of a limited palette, the registration slightly offset at some edges as in a real print, fine bokashi gradation at the horizon lines.
CENTER — Victorian wood engraving: dense white-line engraving on black, foliage, drapery and architectural fragments built entirely from fine parallel and cross-hatched strokes, tonal gradation achieved by line spacing alone.
RIGHT — silverpoint drawing: extremely fine grey metal lines on prepared ground, delicate contour studies of hands, leaves and folded cloth layered over one another, the lines building tone through repetition only.
SCALE — MANDATORY: on all three figures the line spacing is the SAME and the smallest drawn elements are no wider than a fingernail, so the three read as one printer's study.
No transition or blending between figures is needed.

SURFACE — MANDATORY: bone-dry chalky matte finish, NO wet sheen, NO gloss. Lines sit flat in the skin, slightly soft at the edges as printed ink would be.
Pigment applied directly on bare skin, pores and skin texture visible.
Line work dense enough that it reads as continuous tone at full-body scale.
No panel, no band, no skirt or bodice shape.
The paint ends at the wrist and ankle in ONE thin crisp border; hands and feet bare.
ALL SIX hands fully visible, five separated fingers each.
Nails long almond-shaped — LEFT matte indigo, CENTER matte iron black, RIGHT matte silver-grey.

Footwear: all three wear matte bone-white platform stiletto sandals, 3cm platform, open toe with painted toenails visible.
Environment: a print workshop, three framed prints mounted behind, one per figure.
LIGHTING: a single hard key from the front left at 45 degrees, raking across ALL THREE bodies from the same side. Weak rim from behind right. NOT symmetrical multi-sided lighting.
Style: high fashion editorial meeting print study. ultra-sharp 8K. portrait 3:4 vertical.
